record.summary: Apart from the six accepted deviations, the render matches the reference. Each deviation shows exactly as described.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Panels: the render has no Inbox, Queue, Context drift or Chats panel under the tabs; the page is empty below the tabs. Those panels are built in later issues.
accepted_deviations.note: The render has only the starfield background from below the tabs (y about 210) down to the tab bar at y 1543. There are no stray parts of the panels: no headings, borders or Run check button.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tabs: the render's tab row shows Overview and Ideas, where the reference shows Overview, Repositories, Architecture and QA. Only the tabs of shipped increments show.
accepted_deviations.note: Overview is selected and has the same box as in the reference (x 34-143, y 174-210). Ideas has a lightbulb icon and sits right after it in the muted tab style.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Quick chat shows as the reference draws it and does nothing yet.
accepted_deviations.note: The button has the same cyan fill, icon, label, width (x 975-1101) and height (36 px) as in the reference, and it shows no extra state. A static image cannot show its behaviour.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Owner's name: the purpose starts "The owner's personal workspace", where the reference has a person's name. A secret-scan rule keeps the name out of the code.
accepted_deviations.note: The longer opening makes the line end at about x 1007 instead of x 965. The text still fits on one line and nothing is cut off.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Top: the back row with Quick chat, the picture, the name and the purpose sit 4 px higher than in the reference (the design's 28 px top has no spacing token). The tabs are where the reference draws them.
accepted_deviations.note: Measured shifts: Projects back link y 45 to 41, Quick chat top y 28 to 24, picture tile y 80-144 to 76-140, name and purpose up about 3-4 px. The tab row stays at y 174-210 in both images.

accepted_deviations.as_given: Tab bar: the bottom tab bar is the app's shared one in its default order: Home, Inbox, Workspaces, Projects, Artifacts and More. The reference draws Inbox, Workspaces, Projects and More.
accepted_deviations.note: The bar's top edge is at y 1543 in both images, and its height and background match. The six items are centred and Projects is highlighted in cyan, as in the reference.

limits: The full images were viewed scaled down. Differences under about 2 px were checked only inside the given crops (top-left, top-right and the bottom strip).
Quick chat's behaviour and any hover or press states cannot be checked from static images.
